text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Dober! Question for you! What special day 
is today, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Bzzzzt! That's wrong! Here's a hint: it 
has to do with ME!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Waaow! You remembered!☆ Mmm, I'm so happy♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Still, Dober is being mean, yes! 
Pretending not to notice~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I'd forget. I'm not like 
you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Me...? I won't forget either, you know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
You'll forget, won't you? Like homework, 
training gear, or even putting on your 
school uniform— you're always forgetting 
things...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Mmm, that's true, desu ne. However...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I will never forget Dober's birthday! 
Never ever!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. Then... at least in that 
regard, we're the same."
